headline: Worrying approval ratings: ruling party and government change course as 'de facto tax increase' backlash spreads
summary: As the new Democratic Party leadership takes office, the ruling party and government appear to be shifting course on the real estate tax reform and capital-region housing supply measures. Falling approval ratings are cited.
why: Property tax and housing policy shape household wealth, mortgage demand and the government's fiscal position in South Korea.
